name: product-grid
title: Product grid
description: Product cards with a title, description, action, tags, and demo window.
usage: Presenting the main products, two to four of them, with a row of smaller pills for the rest of the API (`MoreApis`, a marquee on phones). Put the agent setup window beside the section heading when the page offers agent setup.
avoid: A black pill in every card (Explore is the outline pill)
Screenshots that ignore the media panel's ring

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
